## Working session summary

Implemented and finalized [PR #195](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/pull/195). It is ready for review, mergeable, and all CI workflows pass on commit `1f5be73`.

### Requirements completed

- Fixed the protected-release PR deadlock:
```text
  - Requires a dedicated `RELEASE_PR_TOKEN`.
  - Uses it for PR creation, check polling, and merging.
  - Waits with `gh pr checks --watch --fail-fast`.
  - Retries only check-discovery and mergeability races.
  - Fails immediately for missing credentials, failed checks, policy failures, or authentication errors.
  - Applied consistently to releases, instant releases, manual changeset PRs, and preview-image automation.
- Pinned all 33 active Linux workflow references across five workflows to `ubuntu-24.04`.
- Added regression tests preventing future `ubuntu-latest` usage.
- Added PAT/GitHub App setup documentation and a patch changeset.
- Preserved macOS, Windows, and ARM runner labels.
```

<details>
<summary>Rest of the working session summary (1 KB)</summary>

````text
```

GitHub confirms that checks from unrelated triggers such as `workflow_dispatch` cannot satisfy a PR’s required checks, supporting the dedicated-token approach. [GitHub required-check documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/how-tos/merge-and-close-pull-requests/troubleshooting-required-status-checks)

A short-lived installation token generated by GitHub’s official [`actions/create-github-app-token`](https://github.com/actions/create-github-app-token) remains a supported alternative to a stored PAT. Pinning the runner follows GitHub’s guidance to use versioned labels when avoiding automatic image migrations. [Runner images documentation](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/main/README.md)
````
